title: The Whiteout
text: The snow is so thick you cannot see the Scion in front of you, a wall of white on every side. The wind screams. Sometimes it sounds like voices calling your names from the wrong direction.

options.label: Dig in and wait it out, without answering the voices.

outcomes.text: You pass a cold night in a snow cave with the voices calling outside.

options.label: The toughest leads on by compass, trusting the needle over their ears.

outcomes.text: They bring you out the far side.
They walk in circles, then over an edge.

options.label: Call out to stay together so no one wanders off.

outcomes.text: Something else calls back from close by.
